verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ اَلسَّمَاوَاتُ تُحَدِّثُ بِمَجْدِ ٱللهِ، وَٱلْفَلَكُ يُخْبِرُ بِعَمَلِ يَدَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

verses.ar: يَوْمٌ إِلَى يَوْمٍ يُذِيعُ كَلَامًا، وَلَيْلٌ إِلَى لَيْلٍ يُبْدِي عِلْمًا.
verses.kjv: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.
verses.web: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

verses.ar: لَا قَوْلَ وَلَا كَلَامَ. لَا يُسْمَعُ صَوْتُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: [There is] no speech nor language, [where] their voice is not heard.
verses.web: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

verses.ar: فِي كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ خَرَجَ مَنْطِقُهُمْ، وَإِلَى أَقْصَى ٱلْمَسْكُونَةِ كَلِمَاتُهُمْ. جَعَلَ لِلشَّمْسِ مَسْكَنًا فِيهَا،
verses.kjv: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.web: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

verses.ar: وَهِيَ مِثْلُ ٱلْعَرُوسِ ٱلْخَارِجِ مِنْ حَجَلَتِهِ. يَبْتَهِجُ مِثْلَ ٱلْجَبَّارِ لِلسِّبَاقِ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ.
verses.kjv: Which [is] as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, [and] rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
verses.web: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

verses.ar: مِنْ أَقْصَى ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ خُرُوجُهَا، وَمَدَارُهَا إِلَى أَقَاصِيهَا، وَلَا شَيْءَ يَخْتَفِي مِنْ حَرِّهَا.
verses.kjv: His going forth [is] from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.web: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

verses.ar: نَامُوسُ ٱلرَّبِّ كَامِلٌ يَرُدُّ ٱلنَّفْسَ. شَهَادَاتُ ٱلرَّبِّ صَادِقَةٌ تُصَيِّرُ ٱلْجَاهِلَ حَكِيمًا.
verses.kjv: The law of the LORD [is] perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD [is] sure, making wise the simple.
verses.web: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.ar: وَصَايَا ٱلرَّبِّ مُسْتَقِيمَةٌ تُفَرِّحُ ٱلْقَلْبَ. أَمْرُ ٱلرَّبِّ طَاهِرٌ يُنِيرُ ٱلْعَيْنَيْنِ.
verses.kjv: The statutes of the LORD [are] right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the LORD [is] pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.web: Yahweh’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. Yahweh’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.ar: خَوْفُ ٱلرَّبِّ نَقِيٌّ ثَابِتٌ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. أَحْكَامُ ٱلرَّبِّ حَقٌّ عَادِلَةٌ كُلُّهَا.
verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD [is] clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the LORD [are] true [and] righteous altogether.
verses.web: The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

verses.ar: أَشْهَى مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْإِبْرِيزِ ٱلْكَثِيرِ، وَأَحْلَى مِنَ ٱلْعَسَلِ وَقَطْرِ ٱلشِّهَادِ.
verses.kjv: More to be desired [are they] than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.web: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا عَبْدُكَ يُحَذَّرُ بِهَا، وَفِي حِفْظِهَا ثَوَابٌ عَظِيمٌ.
verses.kjv: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: [and] in keeping of them [there is] great reward.
verses.web: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

verses.ar: اَلسَّهَوَاتُ مَنْ يَشْعُرُ بِهَا؟ مِنَ ٱلْخَطَايَا ٱلْمُسْتَتِرَةِ أَبْرِئْنِي.
verses.kjv: Who can understand [his] errors? cleanse thou me from secret [faults].
verses.web: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ ٱحْفَظْ عَبْدَكَ فَلَا يَتَسَلَّطُوا عَلَيَّ. حِينَئِذٍ أَكُونُ كَامِلًا وَأَتَبَرَّأُ مِنْ ذَنْبٍ عَظِيمٍ.
verses.kjv: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous [sins;] let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.web: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

verses.ar: لِتَكُنْ أَقْوَالُ فَمِي وَفِكْرُ قَلْبِي مَرْضِيَّةً أَمَامَكَ يَارَبُّ، صَخْرَتِي وَوَلِيِّي.
verses.kjv: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD, my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.web: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
